title: filenode: files_rights in /set,/copy created
description: FileNodeBackend::files_rights (JMAP-0x0q.65) is applied only by FileNode/get. RFC 8620 §5.3 puts server-set properties in created, and draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-16 L431 makes myRights server-set, so FileNode/set create and FileNode/copy created entries should carry the hook's rights rather than the backend's stored myRights. Asking the hook after the insert means an Err after state changed; decide whether such an Err becomes serverFail or leaves the stored value. Related: JMAP-0x0q.73 (FileNode/copy sha256).
notes: Mark 2026-10-21: option (A). files_rights Err after FileNode/set create or FileNode/copy: the create stands and created reports the stored myRights; document in files_rights '# Return mapping'. Otherwise apply the hook's rights in created entries for /set and /copy.
